scenarios.name: idle_consistent
scenarios.description: Reference vector: nothing running, sat 22 °C equals mat 22 °C — air passes through the unit unchanged

scenarios.name: idle_inconsistent
scenarios.description: Reference vector: nothing running but sat 22 °C sits 6 °C below mat 28 °C — no heat transfer surface is active, so one of the two sensors is wrong

scenarios.name: cooling_consistent
scenarios.description: Reference vector: compressor on, sat 13 °C is 12 °C below mat 25 °C — the evaporator is doing exactly what it should

scenarios.name: cooling_inconsistent
scenarios.description: Reference vector: compressor on but sat 27 °C is 2 °C ABOVE mat 25 °C — the coil is adding heat while nominally cooling (lost charge, failed compressor, or a swapped sensor)

scenarios.name: heating_consistent
scenarios.description: Heating branch, healthy: burner on, sat 35 °C is 15 °C above mat 20 °C

scenarios.name: heating_inconsistent
scenarios.description: Heating branch, faulted: burner energized but sat 18 °C is 4 °C below mat 22 °C — heat is called for and none arrives (failed ignition, tripped limit, or no gas)

scenarios.name: edge_idle_deviation_equals_threshold
scenarios.description: Threshold edge: |sat − mat| = 3.0 °C exactly while idle; the comparison is strict, so no fault

scenarios.name: edge_idle_deviation_just_over_threshold
scenarios.description: Threshold edge: |sat − mat| = 3.1 °C while idle clears the strict comparison and alarms after alarm_delay

scenarios.name: edge_cooling_deviation_equals_threshold
scenarios.description: Threshold edge: sat − mat = 1.0 °C exactly with the compressor on; strict comparison, no fault

scenarios.name: edge_cooling_deviation_just_over_threshold
scenarios.description: Threshold edge: sat − mat = 1.1 °C with the compressor on alarms after alarm_delay

scenarios.name: edge_heating_deviation_equals_threshold
scenarios.description: Threshold edge: mat − sat = 1.0 °C exactly with the burner on; strict comparison, no fault

scenarios.name: edge_heating_deviation_just_over_threshold
scenarios.description: Threshold edge: mat − sat = 1.1 °C with the burner on alarms after alarm_delay

scenarios.name: idle_threshold_not_applied_while_cooling
scenarios.description: Mode conditionality: the same 12 °C spread that would be a gross idle violation is normal cooling, and the idle branch is held off by comp_status

scenarios.name: simultaneous_heating_and_cooling
scenarios.description: Compressor and burner both on with sat 30 °C above mat 25 °C: the heating branch is satisfied, the cooling branch is contradicted, and the rule reports the contradiction rather than refereeing the mode

scenarios.name: transient_inconsistency_never_alarms
scenarios.description: Idle inconsistency lasts 1200 s — shorter than alarm_delay — then clears; the persistence timer resets and no alarm is raised

scenarios.name: stage_start_resets_persistence
scenarios.description: An idle inconsistency accumulates for 900 s, then the compressor starts and the temperatures become consistent for cooling; the idle branch drops out and the timer restarts, so the earlier violation never matures into an alarm

scenarios.name: fault_clears_on_recovery
scenarios.description: Sustained idle inconsistency alarms after 1800 s; the alarm drops on the tick the sensors agree again (mat recalibrated at t = 3600 s)
